english.title: Personal licence holder fail to notify licensing authority of name / address change - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a personal licence under the Licensing Act 2003, without reasonable excuse, failed, as soon as reasonably practicable, to notify the licensing authority, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LICENSING AUTHORITY..), of a change in your

(A)_[name]_
(B)_[address]_
(C)_[name and address]_

as stated in the personal licence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 127 of the Licensing Act 2003.
